I always hear people referring to getting massages to remove "knots". How are they formed, and what is happening when they are massaged?
ELI5: Muscle "knots" and massaging them out.

Muscle knots or “trigger points” are small patches of super-contracted muscle fibres that cause aching and stiffness.

https://www.painscience.com/articles/self-massage.php

IIRC, they're patches of muscle that have contracted and for whatever reason won't allow itself to relax and/or stop contracting. If you don't know, muscles only contract. They can't expand. A muscle is "expanded" when its opposing muscle contracts, forcing it to stretch. Think of biceps and triceps on your upper arm - biceps cause your lower arm to contract by contracting, pulling it towards your body. Triceps contract and expand your lower arm away from your body.

"Knots" are when a section of muscle won't allow itself to be expanded/won't stop contracting (I don't know which), causing discomfort and the little hard lump that is the physical "knot." Massaging it causes the muscle to relax and release.
